summary: Session 51 frontend-only E2E verification of the rewritten /wissen editorial knowledge hub. Verified page load with visitor-gate bypass, all 4 sections (Investment-Wissenshub, Themen im Fokus, Ratgeber & Perspektiven, CTA), 6 outbound link navigations, keyboard accessibility (tab order + focus ring + Enter activation), heading hierarchy, mobile 390x844 layout/overflow, console/network hygiene, and full regression on /handeln, /fonds-grundlagen, all 3 /themen/* RelatedKnowledge blocks, the seeded fonds-etfs news cross-link box, and the navbar Wissen dropdown. Result: 100% pass, no functional or design defects found. No code changes were required.

issues: Navbar 'Wissen' dropdown does not expose /themen (Investmentthemen overview) or /handeln (Investment-Wissenshub); both are now prominent on /wissen but are not discoverable from the global nav. Cosmetic/IA suggestion only, not a Session 51 regression.

Focus-visible on hub/topic links relies on box-shadow ring only (computed outline-color is transparent). Ring is clearly visible (gold rgba(201,169,97,0.3) 2px on hub cards, blue rgba(76,124,186,0.38) 4px on topic rows) so keyboard focus is perceivable; noted for reference in case of forced-colors/high-contrast mode where box-shadow is dropped.

critical_code_review_comments: Wissen.js is 309 lines, well structured, HUB_ITEMS/TOPIC_ITEMS extracted as data constants with stable keys — no DRY or file-size issues.

Terminology is consistent with knowledgeGraph.js CTA_BY_TYPE ('Zum Wissenshub' / 'Grundlagen ansehen' / 'Thema verstehen'). Verified rendered text case-insensitively since Tailwind applies uppercase transform.

Optional hardening: add explicit outline-color on focus-visible (e.g. focus-visible:outline-bank-gold) instead of outline-none + ring-only, so focus remains visible under Windows high-contrast/forced-colors mode.
test_credentials: not required — /wissen is public; visitor gate bypassed via localStorage kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent

context_for_next_testing_agent: Session 51 /wissen hub is fully verified (iteration_16) — no open defects, no retest needed. Visitor-gate bypass recipe that works: goto page, set localStorage kapitalmitte_visitor_profile={residence:'DE',role:'private',isUsPerson:false} and kapitalmitte_cookie_consent={necessary:true,analytics:true,marketing:true}, then re-goto. IMPORTANT gotcha: CTA labels on /wissen ('Zum Wissenshub', 'Grundlagen ansehen', 'Thema verstehen', 'Alle Investmentthemen') are rendered UPPERCASE via Tailwind text-transform, so inner_text() returns uppercase — always compare case-insensitively. Baseline RelatedKnowledge item counts: handeln 3, fonds-grundlagen 3, each /themen/* 2. Note /api/auth/me returns 401 for anonymous visitors on every page — this is expected noise, not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — no failures reproduced. The only initially-red assertions in the first run (CTA text 'cta_ok=False' on all 5 hub/topic links) were a test-script artifact: Tailwind's uppercase utility changes the rendered casing returned by inner_text(). Re-running with a case-insensitive comparison confirmed all 5 CTA labels are correct and match knowledgeGraph.js terminology.
